_comment: Coverage ratchet baseline (scripts/coverage_report.py --check). union_binding_*, cells_live and template_cell_liveness_bp may not DECREASE; dead_cells and never_evaluated_rules may not INCREASE. Update only after a deliberate, recorded improvement — never to clear a red gate. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A GREEN: cells_live is the cell-coverage floor. template_cell_liveness_bp is a RATIO whose denominator shrinks with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so both can IMPROVE while coverage is destroyed — measured, deleting the b31/rich run loses 689 live cells while moving liveness 1285->1374bp and dead 55553->47123. Only cells_live and the binding-rule counts fail on that. Separately, every metric is a UNION over the portfolio x regime matrix recorded in provenance, so growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and template_cell_liveness_bp FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet; on a matrix change --check reports the comparison as INVALID rather than as a regression, and the right response is to re-measure and bank the new matrix with the reason in _note — never to drop a portfolio so the old numbers fit again.
_note: Re-banked 2026-08-27 over the 18-run matrix, recording the irb-shapes portfolio (tests/fixtures/reporting_irb_shapes_portfolio.py, registered as RUNS entries 17-18). EVERY ratcheted metric improved, which is unusual for a matrix growth and is worth explaining rather than just banking: union_binding_rules_crr 257 -> 263 (+6), union_binding_rules_b31 289 -> 312 (+23), cells_live 8353 -> 8680 (+327), template_cell_liveness_bp 1310 -> 1358, dead_cells 55393 -> 55215 (-178), never_evaluated_rules UNCHANGED at 785. The usual caveat in the note below - that growing RUNS makes dead_cells RISE and liveness FALL by declaring cells no portfolio fills yet - does NOT bite here, because this portfolio declares no new template column. It emits sheets the estate already declared (corporate, retail_other, project_finance) and fills columns on them that no run had ever reached, so cells_declared barely moves while live cells rise. THE BINDING-RULE GAIN IS CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY: the +6 CRR / +23 B31 split matches EXACTLY the 6 CRR and 23 Basel 3.1 rules that left the vacuity population in the same change (removed from known_vacuous_rules in tests/expected_outputs/reporting/validation_known_breaks.json). A rule leaving VACUOUS becomes PASS or FAIL, which is precisely what union_binding_rules_* counts - two measurements taken by different scripts over different populations agreeing to the rule. Source: one obligor per IRB exposure SHAPE - an issued off-BS item and an undrawn commitment on an IRB corporate, an off-BS leg on a slotting obligor, an apply_fi_scalar LFSE obligor, a defaulted retail_other leg with BEEL strictly below LGD (RWEA 531,250, non-zero, unlike the estate's existing defaulted IRB row whose K = max(0, LGD - BEEL) is exactly 0), a life-policy pledge, and a cash-plus-equity pledge on an F-IRB leg. The companion template-cell census moved 29 column pairs dead -> live (210 -> 239 of 339) over its own 30-run matrix. MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: src/ is UNTOUCHED by this change - the diff is four files under tests/ plus the two baselines - so no engine behaviour moved and the metric delta is attributable to the new runs alone. The BEFORE template-cell census reproduced the previous bank exactly (339 pairs / 210 live / 129 dead / 4.92% fill) before the portfolio was added, which is what makes that attribution safe. TWO NEW ENTRIES IN known_broken_rules accompany this bank, both published-rule limitations with measured proof under the new notes.pattern_non_additive_columns_in_summation_rules: boe_b0744 (ERROR) and boe_b0346 (WARNING). boe_b0744 is ERROR-severity and therefore submission-rejecting; it is banked on the arithmetic that a DISTINCT obligor count cannot equal a sum of overlapping breakdown rows, and it is flagged in its own reason as a one-line revert if that reading is rejected on review. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED because its reasoning about provenance and about why cells_live is the floor is still the authority for those fields --- Re-banked 2026-08-09 (SECOND bank of the day) to record a real coverage INCREASE from task 1.4: cells_live 8193 -> 8353 (+160), dead_cells 55553 -> 55393 (-160), template_cell_liveness_bp 1285 -> 1310. cells_declared is UNCHANGED at 63746 - the increment added liveness without declaring anything, which is why dead_cells fell by the full 160 and the ratio moved the right way. Zero cells lost. Source: four new legs on the registered sa-classes reporting portfolio lighting C 07.00 / OF 07.00 risk-weight rungs 0180 (20%) and 0240 (150%) across four sheets, every row identity non-trivially satisfied (c0200 != c0220 on all four; the 150% legs are the first rows in this portfolio where c0220 > c0200). Four ERROR rules moved VACUOUS -> PASS: v0320_m and v0326_m (CRR), boe_b0483 and boe_b0490 (Basel 3.1). union_binding_rules_crr/b31 and never_evaluated_rules are UNCHANGED, and that is expected rather than a disappointment: none of the 36 rung-identity rules was ever NOT_EVALUATED - they were VACUOUS (evaluated, all operands null) - and union_binding_rules_* is a union across runs, so a rule already PASSing on another portfolio is already counted. Neither headline metric can see a VACUOUS -> PASS improvement. The quantity that moved is per-run VACUOUS, which this script records in runs[] and gates on nothing; that gap is filed. Also measured while banking: the rung-identity rules are sheets_scope 'all', one rule per rung per regime, so lighting a rung on a second sheet buys cells but zero extra rules - converting more of the 36 needs more distinct RUNGS, not more portfolios. MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: every src/**/*.py was hashed before the BEFORE run and after the AFTER run and was identical, and the BEFORE run reproduced the previous bank exactly (8193 / 1285 / 55553 / 785), which independently proves the Art. 121 Table 5 engine work in flight at the time does not move these metrics. --- PREVIOUS BANK'S NOTE, RETAINED because its reasoning about provenance and about why cells_live is the floor is still the authority for those fields --- Re-banked 2026-08-09 over the 16-run matrix. TWO changes, both deliberate. (1) FIRST BANK TO RECORD PROVENANCE. The predecessor was a 12-run measurement taken before the real-estate carrier batch registered re-split x2 and art199 x2 - and of an OLDER TREE: its figures no longer reproduce at either matrix size (re-measuring the 12-run matrix as it stood at the baseline commit gives crr 253 / b31 279 / 1300bp / 52803 dead against the banked 251 / 277 / 1298 / 52817), so those numbers are not a target and cannot be reproduced. dead_cells is banked WORSE in absolute terms (52817 -> 55553) and template_cell_liveness_bp LOWER (1298 -> 1285), and that is a coverage INCREASE, not a loosened gate. What settles it is holding the matrix constant, NOT the direction the metrics moved: cell metrics down while rule metrics up is equally consistent with a real cell loss plus an unrelated rule gain. The decisive figures are absolute - live cells rose 7891 -> 8193 while declared rose 60694 -> 63746, so coverage cannot have fallen. Every one of the 2873 newly-dead cells sits on the C 07.00 / OF 07.00 residential_mortgage sheet, which NO run emitted at 12 and which re-split emits at 16; 123 cells dead at 12 runs are live at 16 (C 07.00 commercial_mortgage, C 09.01 GB/TOTAL); and a live cell CANNOT go dead across a matrix growth because live is a union accumulator over runs and runs 1-12 are identical in both measurements. (2) cells_live ADDED AS THE CELL-COVERAGE FLOOR, banked at 8193. The other two cell numbers are not floors and are sometimes ANTI-signal: liveness is a ratio whose denominator moves with its numerator and dead_cells is declared-minus-live, so dropping declared cells faster than live ones improves both. Measured over all 16 leave-one-out deletions of this matrix: on 4 of 16 BOTH cell metrics moved the passing way while live cells were destroyed - worst is b31/rich, which loses 689 live cells while liveness RISES 1285 -> 1374bp and dead_cells FALLS 55553 -> 47123 (also crr/sa-classes -441, b31/sa-classes -367 with bp -> 1458, b31/re-split -141); on 6 more exactly one of the two passed; only 4 of 16 were caught by both. cells_live fell on all 14 deletions that actually cost live cells and never rose on a loss. The two it did not move for, crr/art199 and b31/art199, cost ZERO live cells - neither contributes a uniquely-live cell, so there was nothing for any cell metric to catch (cells only; that probe did not measure whether those runs are load-bearing for RULE binding). MEASUREMENT PROVENANCE: taken against a pristine `git archive HEAD src` export, not the working tree, because the shared checkout had in-flight engine work at the time (engine/sa/risk_weights.py plus a new engine/sa/sovereign_derived.py - the Art. 121 Table 5 sovereign-derived institution weights). So these numbers describe the COMMITTED engine, which is what the coverage-ratchet CI job measures. Expect the binding-rule counts to RISE when that work lands: --check reports an improvement and exits 0, and banking it is then a normal re-bank. never_evaluated_rules is 785 in every measurement taken.
